What is the increase in length ΔL of the wire
s:
ΔL=Stress.L/Y
Stress on wire = final pressure
PV=nRT
P_f(V+ΔV)=nRT
P_f=2PV/(V+ΔV)
∴ΔV≪V
P_f=2P
ΔL=2PL/Y

t: Two springs have their force constants K₁ and K₂. Both are stretched till their elastic energies are equal. Then, ratio of stretching forces K1/K2 is equal to:

=μN=(4πμBb)Δa
